name: Refractive Surgery Review
tagline: Co-Managing LASIK, PRK, SMILE, and IOL Refractive Procedures
description: A 15-episode series on refractive surgery — patient selection, the procedures, complications, and the optometrist's role in co-management.

episodes.title: LASIK Patient Selection: The Refractive, Topographic, and Ocular Surface Criteria
episodes.description: The refractive range, the pachymetry minimum, the topography exclusion criteria (keratoconus, forme fruste), and the dry eye pre-op assessment.

episodes.title: LASIK Technique: Flap Creation, Excimer Ablation, and the 1-Day Post-Op
episodes.description: The femtosecond vs microkeratome flap, the wavefront-guided vs optimized ablation, and the day-1 post-op optometric exam.

episodes.title: PRK: Indications, the Alcohol Epithelial Removal, and the Painful Recovery
episodes.description: The thin cornea and surface disease indications for PRK, the mitomycin C protocol, and the bandage contact lens and pain management.

episodes.title: SMILE: The Small Incision Lenticule Extraction Procedure
episodes.description: The SMILE femtosecond lenticule technique, the range of correction, and the advantages and limitations vs LASIK.

episodes.title: Phakic IOLs: The ICL for High Myopia Beyond the LASIK Range
episodes.description: The ICL patient selection (high myopia, thin cornea), the vault measurement, and the pigment dispersion and cataract risks.

episodes.title: Refractive Lens Exchange: The Clear Lens Extraction Decision
episodes.description: The RLE patient (presbyope, high ametropia), the IOL selection (multifocal, EDOF, toric), and the risk-benefit discussion.

episodes.title: Presbyopia Correction: Corneal Inlays, Corneal Cross-Linking, and Pharmacologic
episodes.description: The corneal inlay history, the new presbyopia drops (pilocarpine 1.25%), and the surgical presbyopia correction landscape.

episodes.title: Toric IOL Calculations: The Keratometry, Posterior Cornea, and the Barrett Formula
episodes.description: The toric IOL power calculation, the posterior cornea (Barrett Toric), the axis marking, and the post-operative rotation assessment.

episodes.title: Multifocal IOLs: Diffractive, Refractive, and the Patient Selection
episodes.description: The multifocal IOL designs, the patient personality and lifestyle selection criteria, and the dysphotopsia counselling.

episodes.title: EDOF IOLs: The Extended Depth of Focus Design and the Intermediate Vision
episodes.description: The EDOF mechanism, the intermediate vision advantage, and the comparison to multifocal and monofocal IOLs.

episodes.title: The Dissatisfied Refractive Patient: Dry Eye, Residual Refractive Error, and Dysphotopsia
episodes.description: The stepwise workup of the unhappy post-refractive patient, the dry eye treatment, the enhancement decision, and the dysphotopsia management.

episodes.title: Post-Refractive Dry Eye: The Corneal Nerve and the Recovery Timeline
episodes.description: The corneal nerve section mechanism, the 6-month recovery curve, and the aggressive dry eye treatment protocol.

episodes.title: Corneal Ectasia After LASIK: Early Recognition and Cross-Linking
episodes.description: The ectasia risk factors (thin cornea, high correction, forme fruste), the early topographic signs, and the urgent CXL referral.

episodes.title: ICL Complications: Vault, Rotation, and the Cataract Risk
episodes.description: The ICL vault measurement, the rotation and pupillary block risk, and the long-term cataract development and the IOL exchange.

episodes.title: The Future of Refractive Surgery: Lenticule Implants, Cross-Linking, and AI
episodes.description: The emerging refractive technologies — lenticule implantation (Smile Plus), corneal cross-linking for refractive correction, and AI-driven ablation.
